## Summary

- **`http-client.ts`** — check `response.ok` before parsing JSON so non-2xx responses throw `postJson: HTTP <status> <statusText>` instead of silently attempting (and failing) JSON parse; drop unused `response` from return type since all 7 callers only destructure `payload`
- **`image-generation-pipeline.ts`** — fix genuine bug: `isConfigError` was checking `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR` but the contract names the config-error code `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR`, so 503 (service unavailable) and 502 (bad gateway) were swapped for those two error types
- **`generate-pipeline.ts` + `chat-interpretation-pipeline.ts`** — replace unnecessary intermediate variable with optional chaining (`issues[0]?.message ?? fallback`)
- **`tests/unit/http-client.test.ts`** — add `ok` flag to mocks, add explicit HTTP-status-error test case, remove now-nonexistent `result.response` assertion

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run check` — 0 errors
- [x] `npm run test` — 382 passed, 1 skipped (integration gate)
- [x] All 5 changed files reviewed for correctness

## Summary by Sourcery

Tighten HTTP client error handling and clean up core pipeline error mapping and messaging.

Bug Fixes:
- Ensure postJson throws a descriptive error when the HTTP response is not ok instead of failing during JSON parsing.
- Correct image-generation pipeline status mapping by using the IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR code to distinguish configuration errors.

Enhancements:
- Simplify validation error message selection in chat and generate pipelines using optional chaining and nullish coalescing.
- Remove the unused Response object from postJson return type for a narrower, payload-focused API.

Tests:
- Extend HTTP client unit tests to cover non-ok HTTP responses and JSON parse failures while adjusting mocks to align with the new postJson behavior.
